Packet cc2_gun_bot_remainder, read-only analysis. __fastcall(ECX const float3* shooter, EDX const float3* target, float speed, const float3* target_velocity, float* t1, float* t2) -> int, RET 10h, body 008FB8D0-008FBAFB. Builds a = |v|^2 - speed^2 (008FB933), b = dot(shooter - target, v) (008FB949) and c = |shooter - target|^2 (008FB96F), then solves with disc = b*b - 4ac (008FBA02) and roots (b +/- sqrt) / (2a) (008FBA40). The exact intercept needs a linear coefficient of 2*dot(d, v), so the solution under-leads every target that is neither stationary nor exactly abeam. Answers 0, 1 or 2 roots; a degenerate a takes the c/b arm at 008FB99C. docs/GUN_BOT_REMAINDER.md
